title: sonchus picroides
intro: Sonchus picroides, commonly known as thistle or prickly lettuce, is a type of flowering plant in the dandelion family (Asteraceae). This plant has been used in traditional Chinese medicine for its numerous health benefits, which include reducing inflammation, improving liver function, and supporting digestive health. The therapeutic actions of Sonchus picroides include acting as an anti-inflammatory, antioxidant, and hepatoprotective agent, as well as having immunomodulatory and anti-cancer properties. The bioactive constituents of Sonchus picroides include sesquiterpenes, alkaloids, and flavonoids, which contribute to its medicinal properties.
